_guidance.selection_rule: Choose rows using dates, countries, HS codes, product text, and party identifiers together. For broad corridor work, prefer supplier/buyer rollups or ships_to/receives_from traversal before pulling shipment rows.
_guidance.ambiguity_rule: Trade party names can be noisy, partially normalized, or missing entity IDs. Missing supplier, buyer, route, or goods fields means the record is incomplete, not that the relationship is disproved.
_guidance.verification_rule: Verify key counterparties with get_entity_summary or get_entity_profile, and use search_shipments only after narrowing the target slice when you need date- and HS-level confirmation. Confirm opaque HS or risk signals with lookup_hs_codes or lookup_risk_factors before making high-confidence claims.

investigation_notes: Singapore ACRA data is generally high quality — Sayari typically has good coverage of Singapore corporate data. Use the Sayari API to retrieve company profiles, directors, and shareholder information.
Every Singapore company must have at least one resident director — for foreign-owned companies, this director is often a nominee and not the true decision-maker.
The RORC is not public, so UBO data relies on filed shareholder information and cross-references from other jurisdictions.

For full HS code hierarchy and details, use the lookup_hs_codes tool.
